column1: # SweepR DHCP passive-fingerprint signatures (best-effort heuristics, NOT authoritative).
# Hand-authored from publicly-known DHCP option-55 (parameter request list) and option-60
# (vendor class) patterns. The Fingerbank API is deliberately NOT used. Each match carries a
# confidence (high / medium / low); a vendor-class hit outranks a parameter-list hit, which
# outranks a hostname hint (handled in code).
#   pattern      the substring or the comma-separated option list
#   os           OS family / version label to report
